expand_requires: same process-local session and issuing Host provider
retired_commands: All other commands return KDNA_COMMAND_UNAVAILABLE with exit 2; no action authorization
create_input: Bounded UTF-8 JSON with manifest, payload and members containing canonical bytes_base64; no unknown fields are dropped.
save_policy: Atomic no-replace publication; old versions preserved.
source_permission: --allow-source; explicit sha256:... --expected-a required and passed unchanged to native Source
source_edits: Complete manifest and payload objects in strict bounded UTF-8 JSON; original members stay in the original asset and native Source rebuilds derived tables.
source_scope: Public Source only; protected editing uses a separate Host route. Source observation and saving establish no author confirmation or action permission.
